barks.text: No water, no boats, no work. Still here.
Ash makes poor brick and good weight.
Strangers come out of the dust with no cargo.

1.speaker: Dockhand Merrit
1.text: Merrit is coiling a rope that will not be used, and doing it carefully.

3.speaker: Dockhand Merrit
3.text: Up-channel to the flats, when there is water. There has not been water since the barrens drank it, so I mend ropes nobody uses.

4.speaker: Dockhand Merrit
4.text: A place where ash came in by boat and left as bricks. Two of the warehouses are still full of it. Nobody wants bricks made of that.

5.speaker: Dockhand Merrit
5.text: One a season, walking out of the dust with a story and no cargo. You are the first in a while with a sword.

2.speaker: Dockhand Merrit
2.text: Well? The day is not getting shorter.

choices.text: What did Ashport used to be?
